summary.name: Coincide
summary.one_liner: Coincide is a free, open-source native macOS app that runs multiple coding agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) side by side in one window.
use_cases: run several coding agents in one window
schedule recurring prompts for an AI agent
keep long agent jobs running while the Mac stays awake
let an agent operate native Mac apps
dictate prompts to an AI agent by voice
summary.what_it_does: Coincide is a native Swift Mac app that runs several coding agents at the same time in one window, with bots, projects and chats from each agent shown in a shared sidebar. A background host keeps agent turns running after you quit or update the app, and replies continue streaming when you reopen it. It supports scheduled prompts that land in the same thread and wait if the agent is busy, plus Keep Awake to stop the Mac sleeping during long jobs. Agents use each provider's own tool with your sign-in or API key, and voice dictation can use Apple's on-device speech, a local Whisper model, or your own OpenAI or Groq key.
notable: Switch agents mid-conversation within one thread
Background host keeps agent turns running after quitting the app
Appshots: double-press both ⌘ keys to bring the app forward with a window attached
Installable via Homebrew cask or npx
caveats: Requires macOS 26 or later; Windows, Linux and Android are only 'coming', not available
Agents require the user's own provider sign-in or API key
Scheduled tasks that agents create need user approval first
